redfin.remarks: California living meets Rock ’n’ Roll! This one-of-a-kind Tarzana home offers 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and a personality all its own! Artistic touches, unique design elements, and custom lighting create a space that's anything but ordinary. The backyard steals the show! A sparkling pool and resort-inspired setting create the perfect backdrop for unforgettable gatherings, summer barbecues, or simply kicking back and soaking up the California sunshine. For those with a creative side, the custom-built, soundproof multipurpose room within the garage is ready for your next big idea, whether it's making music, creating art, or enjoying your own private escape. A downstairs bedroom and full bathroom add flexibility for guests or extended family. Full of character and creativity, this Tarzana gem is ready for its next chapter. Come see what makes this home truly one of a kind!
